title: Reinforcement Learning for Sequential Solar PV Policy Design under Uncertainty: An Agent-Based Approach
abstract: arXiv:2609.04880v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Designing effective and fiscally sustainable policies for solar photovoltaic (PV) adoption requires balancing adoption gains against public expenditure under uncertainty and heterogeneous decision-making. This study formulates PV policy design as a sequential decision problem and integrates reinforcement learning (RL) with a stochastic agent-based model (ABM) that simulates yearly solar PV adoption under uncertainty. A policymaker agent selects annual incentives, including capital grants, subsidised loan rates, and feed-in tariffs, over a 16-year horizon. Adoption--cost trade-offs are explored by varying policy preferences within a scalarised reward framework. Policies are learned using PPO, SAC, and TD3 and evaluated under stochastic simulation. The results show that this approach produces a clear trade-off structure: the highest-adoption policy (TD3, $w_{\text{cost}}=0.5$) achieves approximately 4,145 adopters at a cost of EUR 41.73 mi

translated_title: 基于智能体的不确定性下太阳能光伏政策序贯设计的强化学习方法
translated_abstract: 为太阳能光伏（PV）普及设计有效且财政可持续的政策，需要在不确定性和异质性决策条件下权衡普及收益与公共支出。本研究将光伏政策设计表述为一个序贯决策问题，并将强化学习（RL）与一个随机的基于智能体的模型（ABM）相结合，该模型用于模拟不确定性下的年度太阳能光伏普及情况。政策制定者智能体在16年的时间跨度内选择年度激励措施，包括资本补助、补贴贷款利率和上网电价。通过在标量化奖励框架内调整政策偏好来探索普及—成本之间的权衡。研究采用PPO、SAC和TD3算法学习政策，并在随机仿真环境下进行评估。结果表明，该方法产生了清晰的权衡结构：最高普及率政策（TD3，w_cost=0.5）以4173万欧元的成本实现了约4145个采用者。
tldr: 本研究将不确定性下的太阳能光伏政策设计构建为序贯决策问题，通过将强化学习（PPO、SAC、TD3）与随机基于智能体模型相结合，学习制定资本补助、补贴贷款利率和上网电价等年度激励政策，揭示了光伏普及率与公共支出之间清晰的权衡结构。
en_tdlr: This study formulates solar PV policy design under uncertainty as a sequential decision problem, integrating reinforcement learning (PPO, SAC, TD3) with a stochastic agent-based model to learn annual incentive policies—capital grants, subsidised loan rates, and feed-in tariffs—revealing a clear trade-off structure between PV adoption and public expenditure.
